subject: Invoice delivery: preferred channel, CC suppression & e-invoice sample
messages:
From: Laura Mitchell <laura.mitchell@clearglass.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@clearglass.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery preferences and a quick question on CCs

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — we’re reconciling our vendor list for Q2 and want to confirm how Redwood will deliver invoices going forward. Our AP team prefers e-invoice (XML) via SFTP or API, but as a fallback we accept PDF by email.

Couple of asks:
- Can you confirm the primary sender address we should expect invoices from?
- We’d like to suppress the billing notification emails to our internal project CC list to avoid duplicates in the AP queue. Is there a way to set the invoice to go only to accounts-payable@clearglass.com?
- If you offer an e-invoice sample (XML schema), could you attach it? That helps our mapping team.

Thanks — we’re trying to onboard Redwood into our AP pipeline this week.

Laura Mitchell
Sr. AP Analyst | ClearGlass Analytics
laura.mitchell@clearglass.com
accounts-payable@clearglass.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Mitchell <laura.mitchell@clearglass.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preferences and a quick question on CCs

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear note. Looping in Kimberly (Billing Ops) and Connor (AP integration) so we can lock this down quickly.

To answer your items:
- Primary sender: invoices will come from billing@redwood.ai. We can also set up an envelope-sender of noreply-invoices@redwood.ai if you prefer a non-personal address.
- CC suppression: yes — we can change the invoice distribution so only accounts-payable@clearglass.com receives the invoice emails. We will preserve a copy to your project mailing list internally in our billing logs for audit but will not send separate notification emails. Please confirm the single delivery address you want.
- e-invoice sample: attaching a lightweight XML example and our remit PDF. Connor, can you confirm SFTP endpoint options and whether we should provide an API webhook for ingest?

Action items I’ll do after you confirm the delivery address:
1) Configure sender address and CC suppression rule.
2) Enable e-invoice XML staging in our account and share credentials (SFTP) or a webhook payload.
3) Ensure PO number (PO#) appears in the <OrderReference> element of the XML (we’ll include guidance).

If you’d like, we can do a 20-minute screen-share with your AP team to test mapping tomorrow.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: invoice_sample.xml (stub), remit_instructions.pdf (stub)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the quick reply. Accounts Payable here.

We confirm: please send invoices only to accounts-payable@clearglass.com (no project CCs). For the e-invoice delivery: SFTP is our preferred method. We’ll give you credentials at onboarding. A couple of notes for the XML payload mapping team:
- Please include PO number in tag <OrderReference> as mentioned.
- Include our billing code in <AccountingCustomerParty>/<PartyIdentification> with value "CG-AP-009" when present.
- We need invoice PDF attached in the SFTP folder alongside XML for human review for the first two invoices.

We can do a test transfer tomorrow morning. Laura will coordinate time.

Thanks — AP Team
